findings.cause: All six actual local-DNS route tests spawn raw origin and proxy handles before fallible setup/request paths. Outer timeout, early error or panic drops handles without cancellation; sequential origin.await?? returns before observing completed proxy error.
findings.remedy: Use existing concrete peer ownership at all spawn sites; explicit request-result cleanup and combined pair result handling, preserving normal H2 client shutdown and every wire oracle.
findings.causal_control: Perform actual SOCKS CONNECT and literal HTTP exchange, retain client outside cancelled owner, then observe both task destruction and socket closure before fallback. Independently complete typed origin/proxy failures and require both error objects retained by returned failure.
findings.classification: source-supported fixture gap; no measured OS leak

findings.cause: read_connect normalizes ATYP 1/3/4 into the same host String; local assertion only parses a loopback IpAddr. A numeric domain encoded with ATYP3 can satisfy it, so literal IP address representation is not independently observed.
findings.remedy: Retain structured SOCKS target representation or independently observe raw CONNECT prefix, requiring IP ATYP1/4 for local DNS while keeping host/port and auth/request positives. Shared support changes need explicit separate ownership.
findings.causal_control: Drive literal CONNECT messages for IPv4/IPv6 positives and a domain-form numeric loopback negative through the actual observer; domain localhost negative remains. No client runtime defect is inferred.

findings.cause: Both actual outer bounded wrappers discard tokio Elapsed and retain only context string.
findings.remedy: Concrete contextual error owning the original Elapsed and exposing it through Error::source; preserve existing timeout periods and operation messages.
findings.causal_control: Poll actual bounded pending operation under paused time, advance its actual timer, require typed Elapsed source; retain successful and typed inner-failure positives.

findings.cause: Top-level raw proxy handles span fallible setup/request and outer cancellation. The queued test also holds raw request task siblings and awaits first?? before sibling; the final test transfers a raw leftover task and can abandon it during early assertion/timeout.
findings.remedy: Concrete existing peer owners or lexical concurrency for all actual workflows; combine request/peer failures and preserve client lifetime required by shutdown. Owned leftover collection must stop and observe failure on exceptional exits.
findings.causal_control: Drive literal accepted request before owner cancellation while external client is alive; completed distinct request/peer failures must survive returned aggregate; preserve exact ordered request, trailer, credential and reuse literals.
findings.classification: source-supported task/result gaps; no host leak reproduction

findings.cause: queued and challenge supervisors discard spawned answer_no_content handles. Returning supervisor after a quiet accept interval neither observes children nor proves their errors/destruction; head snapshots race surviving handlers. Observer writes silently skip poisoned mutex state at904,1629,1636.
findings.remedy: Lexically own child handlers, explicitly classify normal EOF, observe completed failures and bound shutdown/draining before snapshot. Propagate observer mutex failure rather than publishing success-shaped partial state.
findings.causal_control: Actual positive request/head precedes deterministic typed child or observer failure; supervisor must retain cause and stop/drain driven sibling before returning. Normal multi-connection and quiet interval positives remain unchanged.

findings.cause: read_to_end results are discarded, including nested timeout/read outcome in stalled challenge. Empty buffers then support no-replay conclusions even when the observation failed before bytes arrived.
findings.remedy: Match actual read/timeout outcomes deliberately. Preserve typed unexpected I/O errors and operation context; allow only concrete documented normal peer-close forms, with complete/partial quiet-window semantics stated.
findings.causal_control: Use a controlled read returning typed InvalidData before bytes and verify absence observer rejects it; explicit normal EOF and documented disconnect positives, nonempty replay negative, and intentional quiet timeout control.

findings.cause: Local crate imports precede standard/external groups. Several guards/independent validations lack paragraph breaks: local367-371, forward1600-1602,1630-1632,1664-1670. Forward helper/constants split later test groups; its 1962 lines prompt responsibility review without requiring quota splitting.
findings.remedy: Group imports standard/external/local; fix narrow paragraph boundaries alongside scoped ownership repair. Consider extracting the concrete challenge fixture responsibility only if it improves actual caller flow.
findings.causal_control: No test for mechanical layout; targeted rustfmt plus manual operation review, preserve literal assertions.

accepted_contracts: Six local tests observe real auth/CONNECT relay and HTTP1/H2/WebSocket traffic, loopback host and selected port; H2 requires deliberate client drop before closed polling.

Forward raw literal assertions independently preserve absolute form, IDNA, encoded path/query, header order/case, chunk/trailer order, authentication replay, credentials, cookies, client hints and connection reuse.
All explicit listeners bind IPv4 loopback port0; refused-connect test uses held ReservedPort with documented macOS qualification.
read_head has actual 32KiB bound; credential/domain decoding bounded by wire byte lengths. Tests use synthetic credentials and TLS material, no supported real-secret log finding.

Negative accept checks are finite observations, not universal no-future-connection proofs. Unexpected accept errors with outer is_ok generally fail absence rather than falsely pass; this does not preserve their typed diagnostic cause.
rejected_or_unconfirmed: No production local-DNS, replay, protocol or security defect established by these test-source findings.
Do not call lost raw task ownership an infinite OS resource leak without runtime evidence.
read_chunked_message is a deliberately narrow fixture for fixed payload without embedded CRLFCRLF; no general chunk parser correctness or hostile input claim.
Queued sibling yield_now does not independently prove admission readiness before release; this is an unconfirmed strengthening candidate, not a new established production failure.
No need to split code merely for a line quota or introduce shared generic ownership framework.
Diagnostic redaction test checks error Debug/Display only; source-chain secrecy is not proven by that particular assertion, and no leak is established.
